subject_uz: Tayyor BYD avtomobillarini O'zbekiston hududlariga avtovozlarda tashish xizmatlari

requirements.summary_uz: Yuk hajmi yiliga taxminan 20 ming avtomobil.
requirements.summary_en: Cargo volume of roughly 20,000 cars per year.
requirements.quote: Yuk hajmi — taxminan yiliga 20 ming avtomobil.

requirements.summary_uz: Tashuvchining o'z avtoparkida kamida 5 ta avtovoz bo'lishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The carrier must own at least 5 car-carrier trucks.
requirements.quote: Tashuvchi tashishlarning uzluksiz bajarilishini ta'minlash uchun o'z avtoparkida kamida 5 (besh) ta avtovozga ega bo'lishi shart.

requirements.summary_uz: Tijorat yuk tashish uchun amaldagi litsenziya talab etiladi.
requirements.summary_en: A valid commercial freight-transport licence is required.
requirements.quote: Tashuvchi tijorat yuk avtomobil tashishlarini amalga oshirish uchun amaldagi litsenziyaga ega bo'lishi shart.

requirements.summary_uz: Transport vositalari va tashuvchining fuqarolik javobgarligi sug'urta polislari bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Valid vehicle insurance and carrier liability insurance policies are required.
requirements.quote: Tashuvchi amaldagi sug'urta polislariga ega bo'lishi shart: avtotransport vositalarini sug'urtalash va tashuvchining fuqarolik javobgarligini sug'urtalash.

requirements.summary_uz: Barcha transport vositalarida GPS-monitoring bo'lishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: All vehicles must have GPS monitoring.
requirements.quote: Barcha transport vositalarida GPS-monitoring mavjudligi ta'minlanishi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Avtomobillar g'ildiraklaridan maxsus sintetik tasmalar bilan mahkamlanishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Each car must be secured by the wheels with special synthetic straps.
requirements.quote: Mahkamlash: har bir avtomobil g'ildiraklaridan maxsus sintetik tasmalar yordamida ishonchli mahkamlanishi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Haydovchilar xavfsizlik texnikasi va tayyor avtomobillarni tashish qoidalari bo'yicha yo'riqnomadan o'tishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: Drivers must be briefed on safety and rules for transporting finished cars.
requirements.quote: Haydovchilar xavfsizlik texnikasi va tayyor avtomobillarni tashish qoidalari bo'yicha yo'riqnomadan o'tishlari kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: To'lov xizmat ko'rsatilgan fakti bo'yicha, milliy valyutada amalga oshiriladi.
requirements.summary_en: Payment is made after services are rendered, in national currency.
requirements.quote: To'lov xizmatlar ko'rsatilgan fakti bo'yicha amalga oshiriladi.

requirements.summary_uz: Buyurtmachi uzoq muddatli tashish shartnomasi tuzishni mo'ljallagan.
requirements.summary_en: The customer intends a long-term transport contract.
requirements.quote: Xizmat ko'rsatish muddati: Buyurtmachi tashish xizmatlarini ko'rsatish bo'yicha uzoq muddatli shartnoma tuzishni mo'ljallamoqda.

requirements.summary_uz: Oxirgi 3 yillik balanslar (2023-2025) QR kod bilan taqdim etiladi, 5 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Annual balance sheets for 2023-2025 with QR code are scored, 5 points.
requirements.quote: 2023-2025 yillar uchun oxirgi 3 yil uchun QR kod bilan tasdiqlangan yillik balanslarni taqdim etish orqali tanlov ishtirokchisining moliyaviy holati.

requirements.summary_uz: Oxirgi uch yildagi o'xshash hajmdagi ish tajribasi shartnoma va hisob-fakturalar bilan tasdiqlanadi, 5 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Experience on similar volumes over the last three years, backed by contracts and invoices, 5 points.
requirements.quote: Soʼngi uch yil davomida shunga oʼxshash obʼektlar va tanlov hajmlari boʼyicha ish tajribasi

flags.quote: Xizmat ko`rsatuvchining ishonchnomasi va muvofiqlik bayonati (Xizmat ko`rsatuvchining rasmiy dillerlari qatnashgan taqdirda Xizmat ko`rsatuvchidan tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar, rasmiy vakili ekanligini tasdiqlovchi hujjat mavjudligi)
flags.explanation_uz: Mezon 2 sarlavhasi bajarish muddatiga oid, lekin 5 ball ishonchnoma va rasmiy diller/vakil hujjatiga beriladi; bu standart shablon matniga o'xshaydi va yuk tashish xizmatiga kam aloqador. Umumiy 30 balldan 5 ball (o'tish bali 15) shu hujjatga bog'liq, shuning uchun ta'siri cheklangan.
flags.explanation_en: The criterion heading is about performance period, yet its 5 points go to a power of attorney and an official dealer or representative document. This looks like standard template wording and has little bearing on a freight service. It is 5 of 30 points with a pass mark of 15, so the effect is limited.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishtirokchining vakolatli shaxsi nomidan ish yuritish huquqini tasdiqlovchi hujjat (ishonchnoma yoki ustav) taqdim etilishi lozim; rasmiy diller maqomi talab etilmaydi.
flags.rewrite_en: A document confirming the signatory's authority to act for the bidder (power of attorney or charter) must be provided; official-dealer status is not required.
flags.type_label_en: Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase
flags.category_uz: Muayyan ishtirokchilar uchun ustunlik yaratish (Raqobat qo'mitasi tasnifi, 2025)
flags.category_en: Creation of advantages for specific bidders (Competition Committee category, 2025)

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni cheklovchi jiddiy shart topilmadi.

Xarid predmetiga aloqasi bo'lmagan talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Mezon 2 sarlavhasi bajarish muddatiga oid, lekin 5 ball ishonchnoma va rasmiy diller/vakil hujjatiga beriladi; bu standart shablon matniga o'xshaydi va yuk tashish xizmatiga kam aloqador. Umumiy 30 balldan 5 ball (o'tish bali 15) shu hujjatga bog'liq, shuning uchun ta'siri cheklangan.
Buyurtmachining so'nggi 65 ta savdosida ishtirokchilar medianasi 3 ta; savdolarning 46% qismida ikki yoki undan kam ishtirokchi; eng ko'p g'olib bo'lgan yetkazib beruvchi ulushi 8%.
reasons_en: No seriously restrictive condition was found in the document.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (platform criteria form): The criterion heading is about performance period, yet its 5 points go to a power of attorney and an official dealer or representative document. This looks like standard template wording and has little bearing on a freight service. It is 5 of 30 points with a pass mark of 15, so the effect is limited.
In the customer's last 65 deals the median number of bidders was 3; 46% of deals had two or fewer bidders; the most frequent winner took 8%.

documents_needed_uz: 2023-2025 yillar uchun QR kodli yillik buxgalteriya balanslari
Oxirgi uch yildagi o'xshash tashish shartnomalari va hisob-fakturalar
Kompaniya haqida umumiy ma'lumot, ustav va my.mehnat.uz dan xodimlar to'g'risida ma'lumot
Transport vositalari va fuqarolik javobgarligi sug'urta polislari
Avtovozlar ro'yxati va texnik ko'rik hujjatlari
Halollik va qonunchilikka rioya etish to'g'risida ariza
Insofsiz ijrochilar reyestrida yo'qligini tasdiqlovchi ma'lumot

Xarid qilish hujjatlarining texnik qismi talablariga muvofiqligi. Texnik topshiriqqa mos taklifning mavjudligi. (Compliance with the requirements of the technical part of the procurement documents. Availability of a proposal that complies with the technical specifications.)

Xizmat ko`rsatuvchining ishonchnomasi va muvofiqlik bayonati (Xizmat ko`rsatuvchining rasmiy dillerlari qatnashgan taqdirda Xizmat ko`rsatuvchidan tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar, rasmiy vakili ekanligini tasdiqlovchi hujjat mavjudligi) Power of attorney and statement of compliance of the Service Provider (in the case of participation of official dealers of the Service Provider, confirmation documents from the Service Provider, availability of a document confirming the official representative)
Halollik va manfaatlar to'qnashuvi yo'qligi to'g'risidagi kafolat xati (platformadagi shakl bo'yicha)

Soʼngi uch yil davomida shunga oʼxshash obʼektlar va tanlov hajmlari boʼyicha ish tajribasi (shartnoma va xisob-fakturalar ilova qilnishi lozim) Work experience on similar projects and tender volumes over the past three years (contracts and invoices must be attached)

Kompaniya haqida umumiy maʼlumot berish. (my.mehnat.uz dan ishchi xodimlar va mutaxassislar toʼgʼrisida maʼlumot mavjudligi, tashkilot guvoxnomasi va ustavi) Provide general information about the company (availability of information about employees and specialists from my.mehnat.uz, organization certificate and charter)

Kimga: "BYD UZBEKISTAN FACTORY" MCHJ QK, xarid komissiyasiga

Xarid predmeti: Tayyor BYD avtomashinalarini O‘zbekiston Respublikasi hududlari bo‘ylab tashish xizmatlarni xarid qilish
Mavzu: xarid hujjatlari bo'yicha tushuntirish berish to'g'risida so'rov

Hurmatli xarid komissiyasi a'zolari!

Tashkilotimiz mazkur lot bo'yicha xarid hujjatlari bilan tanishib chiqdi va taklif berish niyatida. Hujjatlardagi quyidagi shartlar bo'yicha tushuntirish berishingizni, zarur deb topilgan taqdirda esa ularga tegishli o'zgartirish kiritishingizni so'raymiz.

1. Elektron tizimdagi baholash mezonlari.
   Hujjatdagi matn: «Xizmat ko`rsatuvchining ishonchnomasi va muvofiqlik bayonati (Xizmat ko`rsatuvchining rasmiy dillerlari qatnashgan taqdirda Xizmat ko`rsatuvchidan tasdiqlovchi hujjatlar, rasmiy vakili ekanligini tasdiqlovchi hujjat mavjudligi)»
   Savolimiz: Mezon 2 sarlavhasi bajarish muddatiga oid, lekin 5 ball ishonchnoma va rasmiy diller/vakil hujjatiga beriladi; bu standart shablon matniga o'xshaydi va yuk tashish xizmatiga kam aloqador. Umumiy 30 balldan 5 ball (o'tish bali 15) shu hujjatga bog'liq, shuning uchun ta'siri cheklangan.
   Taklif etilayotgan tahrir: Ishtirokchining vakolatli shaxsi nomidan ish yuritish huquqini tasdiqlovchi hujjat (ishonchnoma yoki ustav) taqdim etilishi lozim; rasmiy diller maqomi talab etilmaydi.

Mazkur shartlarga aniqlik kiritilishi xarid predmetini yetkazib bera oladigan barcha ishtirokchilarning teng sharoitda qatnashishiga va raqobatning kengayishiga xizmat qiladi, deb hisoblaymiz.

Javobingizni tushuntirishlar berish muddati tugagunga qadar (19.11.2026 14:50) elektron tizim orqali taqdim etishingizni so'raymiz.
